column1: # Every distinct pair in the live https://arena.ai/leaderboard flight payload
# where publicName differs from displayName, captured 2026-08-31: 57 of them,
# out of 1029 publicName records and 873 distinct (publicName, displayName)
# The third column is a HAND classification, checked row by row, not the
# output of the classifier under test. Two rows were argued over and are
# recorded here so the argument is visible:
#   glm-5.1 -> glm-5.2 (max)   variant. The version differs, which reads like
#                              a reveal, but both names are the same public
#                              product line and the rule is a shared token.
#   hunyuan-hy3-preview        reveal. The only token the two names share is
#     -> hy4-preview           `preview`, which is a release channel and not an
#                              identity, so the stop list drops it.
# 39 reveals, 18 variants. A raw count of differing rows overstates the reveal
